quotes.text: Retrieval alone provides information. Agency converts that information into process by introducing planning, specialization and verification as your agent service transforms random data pulls into accountable reasoning chains.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the core limitation of single-pass RAG in enterprise settings.

quotes.text: Instead of running one query and crossing its digital fingers, it breaks a problem into parts, assigns tasks to different specialist agents, checks their work, and then synthesizes the outcome.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains agentic RAG in one compact sentence.

quotes.text: It's built around on behalf of authentication, meaning your identity travels with the request. The system doesn't impersonate you. It uses your verified token to fetch only what you have permission to see.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies how agents respect user permissions.

quotes.text: The truth, linear intelligence fails because enterprises aren't linear. Data is distributed, contextual, and often contradictory.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp thesis on why one-query pipelines break down.

quotes.text: The future of enterprise AI isn't bigger prompts. It's smaller feedback loops with better memory and governance.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the episode's outlook on enterprise AI design.

chapters.title: Why your copilot is not smart
Agentic RAG: from search to reasoning

takeaways: Classic RAG runs one query against one index and cannot plan, verify or reconcile data spread across many systems.
Agentic RAG uses a planner, specialist retriever agents and a verifier in an adaptive loop, orchestrated by the Azure AI Agent Service.
On-behalf-of authentication, row-level security and Purview labels keep agent retrieval within each user's permissions and fully auditable.
hook: Most copilots answer from a single retrieval pass and sound confident while missing data that lives in other systems. This episode shows architects and Microsoft 365 admins how agentic RAG combines planning, specialist agents and verification across SharePoint and Microsoft Fabric. You learn how to build copilots that reason over enterprise data while respecting permissions and audit requirements.
